name: migros/add-product
description: Search for one product and add the RIGHT result to the basket - decided by meaning, not by position.

pick.goal: the ordinary everyday version of "{product}" that belongs in a normal Turkish weekly shop
pick.reject: flavoured or dessert versions, lattes, plant-based substitutes (oat/almond/soy/coconut), lactose-free or specialty diet versions, gift packs and bulk catering sizes

steps.note: Position picked a latte, a labne and a baget on three real searches - all scored 0.000. `pick` labels each identical add button with its own card title and asks which one MEANS the product. on_unsure:top because a low margin here means 'several breads are equally fine', not 'I cannot tell': a live ekmek search scored 24 near-identical breads at margin 0.05. The top SCORED option is still a bread; the page's first was a sourdough baguette. max_options:10 keeps probability from spreading across two dozen siblings. expect nearest:last - a stepper ANYWHERE is not evidence once the basket has items; it must appear where this click landed.
